notes.title: Kristala Has Evolved—Play the NEW Demo Now ✨
notes.content:
[h2][b]Happy Friday, Travelers![/b][/h2]

We’re insanely hype to add even more epicness to your weekend with the [b]launch of a new Kristala demo[/b]. That's right! A reimagined introduction to the world of Ailur is officially LIVE MEOW, right here on Steam! 🎉

Why now? Kristala has evolved over the last year, and many players have expressed that [b]the old demo no longer truly matches the overall quality and experience of Kristala [i]today[/i][/b], despite still serving as a solid introduction to the game. 

And, well...[b]we couldn't agree more.[/b] There's so much that's changed when it comes to Kristala's gameplay, which is why we’re insanely excited for you to experience the new demo and dive into your next big adventure (fo' free!).

[previewyoutube=_3edD3R6_OM;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/a4abafc3419cb1cb52ddaa8e3dcdd9379be1dbda.png[/img]

[h2][b]So, What’s New in The New Demo?[/b][/h2]

In short? Well, [b]almost everything.[/b]

You’ll still experience the same content as before—[b]the first half of Chapter I, including the epic boss battle against fan-favorite fish mage Lophi the Lost[/b]—but the systems that power this magical experience have been overhauled since we initially launched the old demo last year.

[b]Here’s a little taste of everything that's changed[/b] between then and now:

[list]
[*] [b]❄️ New Clan & Magic Tree:[/b]
Harness the ancient powers of the newly added Tandara clan, including the ability to unlock and level powerful, ice-based spells on a brand new spell tree. This addition also introduces new class dynamics and expands your arsenal with powerful, ice-infused weapons and abilities.

[*] [b]⚔️ Overhauled Combat:[/b]
Better responsiveness, smoother animations, smarter enemy AI, and an expanded arsenal of weapons and abilities. Plus! Get ready for improvements to all weapons & spells, including refined combat VFX, more powerful weapon abilities, and more diverse combat style.

[*] [b]🕵️ Enhanced Stealth Systems:[/b]  
Enhanced stealth tools for those silent assassins among you, including improved enemy perception and a new detection system to make sneaking even more satisfying.

[*] [b]🌍 World & Environmental Immersion Upgrades:[/b]  
More dynamic lighting, refined VFX/SFX, new enemy spawn animations, and overall environmental detailing to immerse you deeper into Ailur.

[*] [b]📜 More Intuitive Menu/UI Systems:[/b]  
Our entire UI is getting a complete overhaul. Get ready to enjoy redesigned menus and HUD for better clarity and accessibility.

[*] [b]🐞 Major Bug Fixes & Optimizations:[/b]  
Faster load times, higher framerates, and an all-around smoother performance experience.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/7753a09035d5f550748b0b0db138148949c95e41.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/a4abafc3419cb1cb52ddaa8e3dcdd9379be1dbda.png[/img]

[h2][b]More Exciting News Comin' Soon[/b][/h2]

Whether you're a seasoned Early Access player already or totally new to the world of Kristala, [b]this new demo reflects the true quality and direction of the game[/b] as we head closer to a full 1.0 release.

We want our new players to experience an accurate and authentic first look at what Kristala is really like while simultaneously allowing returning players to see just how far we've come. So GO, GO, GO! [b]Download the new demo, check out the changes, and let us know what you think![/b]

This is [b]just the start of some incredibly exciting new initiatives we’ll be rolling out for Kristala this year[/b], so stay tuned, Travelers! As always, thank you for being on this epic journey with us. Your feedback, support, and passion mean the world.

With claws bared and spells at the ready.

[b]—The Astral Clocktower Studios Team[/b]

notes.title: ✨ARPG Kristala’s Enemy AI Update Arrives April 1st!✨
notes.content:
[h2]Ailur’s chosen, [b]prepare yourselves![/b]⚔️ [/h2]

Our next impactful content update is [b]dropping right here on Steam on April 1st[/b], bringing you a ton of [b]new features, enemy AI refinements, and highly requested improvements to combat, enemy behavior, and the game’s core combat and stealth systems[/b]—all based directly on your feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/ac89fab62a389ce12959ad3a98e7adfe6b44002f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/a4abafc3419cb1cb52ddaa8e3dcdd9379be1dbda.png[/img]

[h2]Here’s a [b]detailed breakdown of what’s coming in Kristala's April "Enemy AI" Update:[/b][/h2]

[b][h3]🧠 Smarter, Deadlier Enemies[/h3][/b][list][*] Improved stealth and enemy perception make sneaking even more satisfying.
[*] New detection bar: Enemies now have three states—Detect, Investigate, and Alert.
[*] If you stay out of sight long enough, enemies will “forget” about you and return to their idle state.
[*] Hidden enemies (Spiders, Zombies, Lizards, Fungal variants) now have an Ambush Mode, programmed to strike as soon as they spawn (bypassing the Detect and Investigate states).
[*] More ranged enemies are entering the game, with enemies shifting between melee and ranged combat depending on player distance.
[*] No more enemies leaping into the abyss! If foes can’t reach you, they’ll either attack at range or patrol, waiting for an opening to strike.
[/list]
[b][h3]⚔️ Better Group Combat & Enemy AI[/h3][/b][list][*] Enemies will no longer attack all at once—they’ll surround and take turns attacking based on an "aggression meter."
[*] Tougher enemies (Ravager, Assassin) will be more aggressive, attacking more frequently than weaker enemies (Defenders, Gunners).
[/list]
[b][h3]🔥 Weapon & Spell Improvements[/h3][/b][list][*] Refined special attack VFX for a more polished feel.
[*] More powerful weapon abilities—but with increased mana costs.
[*] Rebalanced spells to make each choice more meaningful.
[/list]
[b][h3]👑 Two New Bosses + Major Boss Refinements[/h3][/b][list][*] Her royal majesty, Rhylotha, descends into Kristala! Face her terrifying, eight-legged challenge in the dark forests and caves of Dalamase.
[*] The Myrtunan Shard Guardian (wielding a crystal-encrusted Greatsword) awaits those brave enough to test their mastery of Ailur's necromantic spirit magic.
[*] All existing bosses have been rebalanced and polished, with improved animations and mechanics.
[/list]
[b][h3]💀 New Enemy Spawn Animations[/h3][/b][list][*] Watch out! Enemies like the Masarusa, Undead, Spiders, and Gilsanka now emerge straight from the ground—ambushing unsuspecting players.
[/list]
[b][h3]📜 New Menus & UI Enhancements[/h3][/b][list][*] Spell selection added to the Character Creation menu.
[*] Equipment Menu overhaul for a smoother experience.
[*] If time allows between now and Tuesday, we'll also launch the new Spell Tree and Inventory menus. Def stay tuned!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/a4abafc3419cb1cb52ddaa8e3dcdd9379be1dbda.png[/img]

This update signals another impactful step forward for Kristala’s Early Access journey, and we [i]can’t wait[/i] for you to experience all the polishes and refinements firsthand!

[b][h2]Mark your calendars—April 1st is coming! 😼⚔️[/h2][/b]
What are you most excited for? Let us know in the comments!

notes.title: MAJOR New Content Update Coming in February 🙀
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/d282913ea4fc32b9d9888cc69313cd2df05a2d81.jpg[/img]

Greetings, dearest Travelers!

February is officially around the corner, and we're gearing up for a MAJOR content update that will be dropping very soon right here on Steam.

What new content can you expect next month? We're so glad you asked! Here's a rundown of the fresh features and new mechanics comin' your way:

[list]
[*] Addition of an [b]Important new NPC & ongoing questline[/b]
[*] Initial implementation of a [b]fully redesigned Menu / UI system[/b]
[*] New mechanics tied to [b]Food items[/b] (snackable consumables and dish recipes!)
[*] [b]Tools & Tool Crafting Menu[/b] added (did someone say throwing knives?!)
[*] [b]Projectile-Throwing & Climbing Enemies[/b] - and yes, they can climb onto rooftops, too... 
[*] [b]Dodge attacks + quicker takedowns[/b] to go along with the existing, slow-mo ones 
[*] [b]Filling in of existing animation gaps[/b] (more realistic parkour movements & NPC dialogue interactions, refined enemy spawn movements, etc.)
[*] [b]Chapter I Localized in 4 key languages[/b]: French, German, Spanish LATAM, and Brazilian Portuguese)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/a4abafc3419cb1cb52ddaa8e3dcdd9379be1dbda.png[/img]

[b]When we say, "important new NPC & questline," we really mean it! [/b] Over the last few months, we've been quietly working on an EPIC new collaboration with a very popular YouTuber in the gaming space.[/b]

Who is this mystery collaborator? We'll be revealing that early next week, but they'll be making their voice-acting debut in Kristala as Gustav Gondasa, a spirited rodent with a penchant for rare nuts who will play an important role throughout the entirety of the game.

We'll be sharing more insight into all the new goodies we've lovingly packed into this update when we officially unveil the mystery Traveler who will be bringing Gustav to life, but here's a sneak peek at his full character model to hold you over until then.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/064f9c913614c5ff68808bf568b1d4c8cf83d078.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/a4abafc3419cb1cb52ddaa8e3dcdd9379be1dbda.png[/img]

BUT WAIT, THERE'S MORE! With this next big update on deck for February, the release for our third Chapter has officially been pushed back to March 2025 - and we promise the wait will be well worth it.

Not only will this next installment feature the biome for our ice-magic clan, the Tandarans, but it's also the first open world-style level in Kristala, which means you can expect to roam the tundras of Tandar on your trusty CANINE STEED! 

That's just the tip of the iceberg (pun def intended) for what's in store for Kristala this year, and we'll be sharing lots more details as our future launches approach. [b]For now, check out the revised Early Access Roadmap, which has officially been updated to accommodate all our upcoming launches.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/2f694b03ddd2692cbec06544ea1c164214647c34.jpg[/img]
As always, you can find this Timeline right on the main description of the Kristala Steam store page, as well as on our website. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Kristala Version 0.2.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes for Kristala Version 0.2.0.1[/h1]

[b]The following is a list of features, fixes, and updates added to Kristala Version 0.2.0.1[/b]

[h2]Features & Highlights[/h2]

[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new Wall Jump mechanic has been added with more controlled movement, allowing the player to grasp onto the wall for a few seconds before leaping to the next ledge or cliff.
[*] An emergency button has been added to the bug reporter menu. If you become stuck and aren’t able to get out using a teleport item, you can use this button to teleport to your last-interacted Ellarial Font checkpoint. Please do still report the bug so we may document your location when the tool is used.
[*] A Tandaran starting Talisman has been added.
[*] The tutorial prompt for the Wall Jump mechanic has been updated.
[*] Your character will no longer perform random idle animations while engaged in dialogue with NPCs–a change made based on player feedback to increase the overall immersion of the game.
[/list]
[h3]VFX[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Kotakayan Rot Helm now has a “stink trail” VFX attached to it.
[*] Ghost hands and fog areas have been added in places where a soft death may occur in the city of Myr.
[/list]
[h3]Sound Design[/h3]
[list]
[*] The SFX for Hiratrola the Abandoned Son’s scream attack has been increased / intensified.
[/list]
[h3]Menu / UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] The overall visual aesthetic of the Feline Skill Tree has been improved.
[*] The proper icons for Rings and Tail Charms have been added.
[/list]
[h3]Spells[/h3]
[list]
[*] The damage for the Tandaran Crystal Pike spell has been adjusted so that it’s no longer too OP.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/a4abafc3419cb1cb52ddaa8e3dcdd9379be1dbda.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes for Kristala Version 0.2.0.1[/h1]

[b]The following is a list of bugs we've addressed in Kristala Version 0.2.0.1 [/b]

[h3]Menu / UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Inventory Menu now scrolls and no longer shows compacted slots when the item threshold has been hit.
[*] An issue preventing the Inventory Menu from displaying Tail Charms has been fixed.
[/list]
[h3]Spells[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Ice Armor spell now negates a small amount of incoming damage instead of negating *all* damage.
[*] The decals for the Cone of Cold and Crystal Pike spells have been adjusted.
[/list]
[h3]Traversal[/h3]
[list]
[*] You will no longer get stuck while performing Wall Runs when interacting with them too close to the wall.
[*] The scratch-mark decals will no longer show on your character when performing a Wall Run.
[*] The character will no longer attempt to mantle objects when simply attempting to drop down from them.
[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] Longer lines of NPC dialogue will no longer overlap with player respondes.
[*] The item name for the Ring of Finesse now properly says Finesse instead of Strength.
[*] Rings now properly add the correct effect to your character stats.
[*] Your character will no longer become stuck when attempting to stand up, jump, or block when in small passageways.
[*] Bosses now immediately detect you when entering their arenas.
[*] Interacting with doors and gates that are “locked from the other side” now work as intended.
[*] Lophi the Lost’s red-warning Jump Attack can no longer be blocked.
[*] A bug that showed the weapon displaced during spell casts has been fixed.
[*] The character’s fur now shows properly when the Angler Armor Set is equipped.
[*] Many additional fixes through Nisargan and Myrtunan biomes have been made.
[/list]

We appreciate all the continued feedback and bug reports you've been submitting and welcome additional reporting and quality-of-life suggestions as we continue to refine and optimize the game. 

We also welcome your honest, constructive feedback in official reviews here on Steam. Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Chapter II of Kristala is now Live!
notes.content:
[h2]The wait is over, Traveler! Are [i]you[/i] ready?![/h2]

Sharpen your claws, because the Tandara clan is officially ready for play, along with a new, comprehensive ice-magic skill tree. Don’t wait! Go! Explore the eerie new, necromantic Myrtuna biome, including the capital city of Myr. We’ve got new quests, new bosses, new weapons and armor sets—and now, so do you (plus wall running...there’s wall running now, too!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/a3d280972a62dd86722c142961b1f6149bafee3b.png[/img]
For full details (in case you missed it), see [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1206410/view/4522268459977378197]this previous announcement[/url]!

If you’re new to our ongoing saga, Kristala is currently offered at an impressive 31% discount; don’t miss your chance to fully sink your claws into our unfolding story! And stay tuned for the release of our two exclusive, in-game aesthetic items - coming VERY SOON as DLC! Spook-meter on full capacity!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/66f0c52406fcde36d8e8f38c327e3ee73ddc65a3.png[/img]
[b]If you like lists, here’s a list of all the epic new goodies we’ve just launched into the world of Ailur:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Necromantic Myrtuna Biome. Two new wild areas, plus a capital city full of mystery and adventure!
[*] Introducing the Ice Clan! The frosty Tandara clan finally makes its appearance, with new options added to the character creator, powerful Ice spells, and a leveling tree to match! Keep it chill!
[*] Heaping Helping of Story Content. Continue to unravel the mystery and explore the world for fantastic feline rewards! New NPCs, questlines, and story beats via Kristal Memories! 
[*] A More Dangerous World—and More Dangerous Tools to Face It. Ten new enemies wandering Ailur, as well as several new bosses—including a special Halloween bonus boss coming soon—will force players to carefully hone their skills…but new weapons, armor sets, and feline traversal skills will ensure you're fully ready for the fierce challenge ahead!
[/list]
If this all sounds exciting, then pounce right in, because Chapter II awaits! Think you know of a YouTuber or streamer who'd love Kristala? There's never been a better time for all your favorites to get involved, so don’t be shy—let them know!

[h3]Come, Traveler...the Kristals are calling.[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/a4abafc3419cb1cb52ddaa8e3dcdd9379be1dbda.png[/img]

[h2]Known Bugs for Kristala Version 0.2.0.0[/h2]

The following if a list of known bugs we're currently working on addressing for Kristala Version 0.2.0.0. Stay tuned to future patch notes for updates on these issues.

[list]
[*] If you have [b]many items in your Inventory[/b], adding an item to your Quick Bar will cause all items to appear condensed  on your screen.
[*] When [b]viewing an Inventory[/b] that has more items than can fit on a single screen, a seemingly immovable scroll bar will appear; physically grab the bar to scroll down and view off-screen items.
[*] At times, [b]enemies hit with a spell [/b]will walk slowly toward you vs. running after you; hitting them a second time should make them return to normal.
[*] Some [b]doors and gates[/b] don’t actually open from one side or the other as intended.
[*] [b]Knocking enemies into water or holes[/b] may cause them to disappear, preventing you from receiving XP; bosses, however, will respawn in this same scenario.
[*] There are currently [b]two Strength Rings in the game[/b]; when equipped, however, one is actually a Finesse Ring. Equip any Rings you find to determine if they affect Strength or Finesse stats.
[*] [b]Placing a "Named" Ring in an Inventory slot[/b] shows stacked bonus stats for ALL Rings within that slot (for example, a slot that shows (3) Strength Rings allows you to gain (9) Strength from a single ring when equipped).
[*] [b]Some enemies will refuse to chase you[/b], even after they notice you; instead, they’ll turn toward you and only attack if you get close enough.
[*] [b]Some enemies may seem to “glide”[/b] vs. walk; all other enemy animations will be fine, and the glide issue will be fixed after they chase you.
[*] [b]You may randomly start "floating" while exploring[/b] some area; repeatedly jumping and/or dodging will fix this issue.
[*] Some [b]game assets may be seen loading in[/b] as you enter new areas or when you initially load into the game.
[*] At times, [b]the game’s music[/b] may abruptly stop working. This usually stops when you interact with an Ellarial Font checkpoint; you can also restart the game to fix it.
[*] Some [b]Wall Grab spots[/b] are difficult to grab, and a few may not work at all. This is not something that happens for every player, and we’re actively investigating a fix.
[*] The[b] Ice Armor Spell [/b]completely negates all physical damage until it breaks, which only happens from status-effect damage.
[*] The [b]Flaming Skull Helmet[/b] sometimes randomly removes itself when you hit a loading screen (this includes changing maps, teleporting, fast traveling, dying—and potentially other scenarios)
[/list]

notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes for Kristala Version 0.1.3.0[/h1]

[b][h3]IMPORTANT - PLEASE READ[/h3][/b]
A bug related to pre-existing game saves (dating from mid-July and prior), causing the player character to load-in without armor and other key items, has been pinpointed in Kristala Version 0.1.3.0. We are actively working on a fix to be pushed ASAP.

The issue relates to an implementation for backwards compatibility that was pushed in our mid-July update. To prevent any loss of data or inventory items, any existing saves made within the affected date range should be backed up before opening. We recommend starting a new game to avoid this issue and enjoy all the new content added to Kristala since its initial launch.

[b]-The Kristala Dev Team[/b]

-   -   -   -   -

[h3]Features & Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[olist]
[*] MASSIVE IMPORVEMENTS TO OVERALL OPTIMIZATION, significantly improving performance within the Main Menu and in the general Dalamase levels.
[*] Standing in/near Corruption Spores will no longer kill you; instead, the spores will deal an amount of damage before respawning you.
[*] Support for backward compatibility of Save Games is in the process of being implemented.
[*] The overall momentum for the Wall Jump mechanic has been adjusted.
[*] The chance for Blocking enemies has been increased; they’re no longer likely to Block all attacks anymore.
[*] The Keepers of the Hedge now feature another combo attack.
[*] Many improvements–and a few new additions–have been made to the characters’ animations.
[*] The Difficulty menu now includes related images for each difficulty mode/selection.
[*] When using a Gamepad, the Right Face Button (B/Circle) was added as an acceptable key to close the Photo Mode.
[*] The game’s Credits have been re-added to the end of the level, upon defeat of the Shard Guardian.
[*] After Teleporting to an Ellarial Font checkpoint, you will now return to this same Font upon death or when using a warp consumable.
[/olist][/list][list]
[*] [b]VFX[/b]
[olist]
[*] Improvements for Claw attack trails have been made to attacks for the Player and Shard Guardian boss.
[*] New additions and improvements have been made to the Shard Guardian boss’s overall effects.
[*] Effects for the portal that transports you to the Shard Guardian realm have been tweaked.
[*] Enchantment effects for the Greatsword weapon type have been improved.
[/olist][/list][list]
[*] [b]Sound[/b]
[olist]
[*] Ambient sounds for Dalamase have been altered and improved.
[*] The sound effects for Exploding Rock assets have been significantly improved.
[*] The sound effects that trigger when swinging the Greatsword weapon have been improved.
[*] Dialogue for Brutus the Blacksmith has been added to the game.
[/olist][/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]UI[/b]
[olist]
[*] The Quest UI now appropriately indicates the required number of items needed for a given task, without counting above the exact number needed (for example, if you need 3 of a certain item and already have 5 in your inventory, the Quest UI will show 3/3 instead of 5/3).
[*] Visibility related to Quest UI has been improved.
[*] Many Focus issues within the menu systems have been addressed.
[*] At times, the Checkpoint menu opened with nothing showing on the screen; this has been addressed.
[/olist][/list][list]
[*] [b]Features[/b]
[olist]
[*] Taking damage over time no longer causes your Poise to break.
[*] The Player Character no longer enters T-Pose when transitioning between two animations.
[*] Landing from a high jump and performing a dash was causing a weird pose during the dash.
[*] Dashing after landing from a high jump no longer results in the character performing a strange pose.
[*] All weapon trail effects now return to normal once the effects that trigger for Special Attacks have concluded.
[*] The issue causing players to remain stuck on the "Defeat Hira" Quest, even after defeating Hiratrola, has been fixed.
[*] Destroying Corruption Bulbs or Exploding Rocks now updates the navigation, preventing enemies from getting stuck in obstacles.
[/olist]
[/list]
[h1]Known Bugs for Kristala Version 0.1.3.0[/h1]

The following is a brief list of known bugs and issues we're actively working on addressing in Kristala Version 0.1.3.0. Updates on these issues will be detailed in future patch notes.

[list]
[*] Lophi’s boss-fight musical track often restarts right after it begins; we’re looking into this.
[*] Interactions with NPC Zazagrul sometimes fail to show properly, but if you move away from Zaza and then return to her, they should work again.
[*] Holding keys to both Finish Dialogue and Open Items within the Inventory currently isn't working; this will be addressed soon.
[*] The Cancel button isn’t currently working in the Bug Reporter tool, but you can still navigate to the top panel to exit the tool.
[*] Some Spider enemies may not move in the Fungalwood Forest area of Dalamase; we’re working on addressing this.
[*] At times, the game may crash when you attempt to take a picture using the Photo Mode tool; this is a top priority fix for us.
[/list]
We appreciate all the continued feedback and bug reports you've been submitting and welcome additional reporting and quality-of-life suggestions as we continue to refine and optimize the game. 

We also welcome your honest, constructive feedback in official reviews here on Steam. Thank you for your continued support.

[h3]Features & Highlights[/h3]
[list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Kristala Version 0.1.2.0
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes for Kristala Version 0.1.2.0[/h1]

The following patch notes detail all the features, highlights, and bug fixes included in Kristala Version 0.1.2.0. With this significant update, Episode 1 of Kristala's Early Access release is now 95% complete.

[h3]Features & Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] Addition of the [b]Capital City of Nisar[/b] (accessible through the main questline). If you have already completed the level, you may visit Nisar by picking up a key from the final Ellarial Font, allowing you to travel back to the starting Font and bypass the locked gate at the start of the level.
[*] You can now [b]upgrade your weapons[/b] by visiting [b]Brutus the Blacksmith[/b].
[*] A [b] third boss fight[/b] has been added to the game, accessible from the city of Nisar.
[*] [b]Various NPCs and Questlines have been added[/b], including Prada Lun, Levida, and Grinning Grimaldi.
[*] Addition of a[b] Greatsword Weapon type (plus two new classes)[/b]. If you have already completed the level, you can find the Greatsword as a pickup near the final Ellarial Font.
[*] [b]Dynamic Difficulty mode[/b] added to the game. Begin a New Game to start your journey in a dynamic difficulty, or toggle the dynamic difficulty on/off within the game's Settings.
[*] An option to [b]hide the HUD[/b] has been added to the Settings menu.
[*] Various [b]minor adjustments to combat[/b] have been pushed to make the overall combat experience even more interesting and fun.
[*] Many improvements have been made to [b]navigation within the Menu system[/b].
[*] The [b]Spell Tree’s overall presentation[/b] has been improved (prices of Spells now added and clearer focus to the UI).
[*] The [b]Drain life spell[/b] can now be used until you run out of Mana.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Menu Systems:[/b] 
[olist]
[*] Bugs related to binding new controls are now fixed.
[*] Bugs that caused Menus to "freeze" are now fixed.
[/olist] [*] [b]Spells:[/b] 
[olist]
[*] The Roar spell's perk no longer plays its related sound before the spell is actually cast (it was previously spawning alongside the spell itself being cast).
[*] The Invigorate spell's perk now also works as it should, healing an instant amount of Health before continuously healing the caster.
[/olist] [*] [b]NPCs:[/b] 
[olist]
[*] NPCs that don't have an active dialogue cannot be interacted with and now use the correct idle animation(s). 
[*] Some dialogues were automatically progressing after a few seconds, resulting in some voice lines being cut short. They are now correctly timed.
[*] Distance dialogues now won’t play twice if you move back and forth without completing them.
[*] Single-distance dialogues won't play again if you reload the map (either by dying or by loading a game).
[*] NPCs will no longer spawn appearing to float or seem as if they're buried in the ground.
[*] Enemies now no longer fail to rotate towards you during combat.
[/olist] [*] [b]Miscellaneous:[/b]
[olist]
[*] All boss music now correctly stops after you die.
[*] An issue causing characters (both the player and the enemies) to fall through the terrain has now been fixed in the vast majority of cases.
[/olist]
[/list]
[h1]Known Bugs for Kristala Version 0.1.2.0[/h1]

The following is a list of known bugs and issues we're actively working on addressing in Kristala Version 0.1.2.0. Updates on these issues will be detailed in future patch notes.

[list]
[*] The NPCs' quests will not work properly if you've already progressed further than their area.
[*] Some dialogues automatically progress after a few seconds, resulting in some voice lines being cut short.
[*] After receiving a takedown, enemies will not take damage and will temporarily behave abnormally.
[*] The character is experiencing a load-delay in the Character Creation menu, resulting in some invisible areas showing before they load in.
[*] The character jumps when closing a tutorial.
[/list]

We appreciate all the continued feedback and bug reports you've been submitting and welcome additional reporting and quality-of-life suggestions as we continue to refine and optimize the game. 

We also welcome your honest, constructive feedback in official reviews here on Steam. Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Kristala Version 0.1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes for Kristala 0.1.1[/h1]

The following patch notes detail all the fixes and updates included in Kristala Version 0.1.1.

[list]
[*] [b]Rebinding keys[/b] in the Controls Settings Menu were fixed.
[*] The game’s [b]Photo Mode[/b] is now working as it should.
[*] The [b]DLSS default mode[/b] has been turned off.
[*] The [b]Grass Density default value[/b] has been set to High.
[*] [b]Fixed UI issues[/b] related to equipped items.
[*] [b]Motion Blur and Bloom settings[/b] now work as they should.
[*] A slider to control [b]mouse sensitivity[/b] is now available within the Settings menu.
[*] An issue preventing [b]enemies from properly spawning[/b] has been fixed (some were falling through the terrain, causing them to disappear and granting random XP and items).
[*] [b]Voice options A and B [/b]can now be played and previewed within the Character Creation menu.
[*] [b]Fur options will now show even with Effect Settings set to Low [/b]in the Character Creation menu.
[*] [b]The Character Creation menu[/b] now shows a confirmation pop up to finalize or discard your customization selections/changes.
[*] Navigation and displacement of elements within the [b]Spell Tree menu[/b] have been addressed and improved.
[*] The overall player experience within the [b]Shop menu[/b] has been improved.
[*] [b]Camera issues related to dizziness[/b] while playing have been addressed.
[*] [b]The camera will no longer move when using the mouse/touchpad[/b] while playing with a gamepad.
[*] The camera will no longer behave abnormally during[b] frame rate drops.[/b]
[*] [b]The camera rotation lagging[/b] has been adjusted to improve the overall experience and avoid motion sickness.
[*] [b]A small deadzone has been added to the camera input[/b] to avoid the camera from moving on its own.
[*] The [b]camera auto rotate[/b] has been adjusted to not interfere with the regular movement.
[*] The [b]overall damage coming from Poison and Bleeding[/b] has been adjusted, preventing a massive amount of damage from applying when stacking.
[/list]


[h1]Known Bugs for Kristala 0.1.1[/h1]

The following is a list of known bugs and issues we're actively working on addressing in Kristala Version 0.1.1. Updates on these issues will be detailed in future patch notes.

[list]
[*] The character is experiencing a load-delay in the Character Creation menu, resulting in some invisible areas showing before they load in.
[*] The game has been presenting some issues for players with AMD video cards; we’re investigating this and will update you ASAP.
[*] The performance still needs further optimization, particularly for cards below series 20’s. If you have one of these cards, the game may freeze/crash at times; we’re actively working on addressing this issue.
[*] Players may fall through the terrain in some areas; this appears to be completely random, and we are actively investigating the issue to address it as soon as possible. To work around this issue, quit to the main menu and reload your game.
[*] At times, enemies may fail to take damage if they're not yet engaged in combat.
[*] Some enemies may appear to randomly glitch and “dance” during combat. Typically, continuing to attack the enemies will fix this issue.
[*] Some of the input icons may appear incorrectly after you change them; this only affects the icons themselves - your changes will be retained.
[*] NPC Zazagrul may appear floating or with half of her body underground.
[*] Some enemies may appear underground but will focus on you as soon as they notice you.
[/list]

We appreciate all the feedback and bug reports you've been submitting and welcome additional reporting and quality-of-life suggestions as we continue to refine and optimize the game. Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Kristala Demo Update Notes July 27, 2023
notes.content:
Kristala Demo Update Notes July 27, 2023:

- Big improvements and polishing done on the combat systems
- Complete overhaul of our AI system
- Also big improvements and detailing on the level design
- Adjustments to the lighting in Dalamase
- Improved the performance of our spawning system.
- Overall optimization and reduction of RAM/VRAM consumption
- DLSS options added to the settings menu
- Added two new armor sets
- Improvements to menus
- Photo mode added

Remaining known issues:

- Twigativa enemies don't break into pieces as before, the system we used for destructibles turned out to be unstable in UE5.2 which forced us to make them disappear instead of breaking temporarily.
- Enemies occasionally get stuck in place and stop responding, very rare but exists nonetheless. Will be addressed in the next update.
